films.title: No One Will Save You
films.overview: A lonely woman battles extraterrestrials who threaten her future while forcing her to face her past.

films.title: Whalefall
films.overview: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

films.title: Spontaneous
films.overview: When students in their high school begin inexplicably exploding (literally), seniors Mara and Dylan struggle to survive in a world where each moment may be their last.
